🚨 Important Update - Please Read 🚨

Hey everyone, I wanted to take a moment to share something serious that happened recently. 

Katie was unfortunately targeted in an social engineering attack. We don't know the attacker's goals, but it's a reminder of how vulnerable we can all be to these kinds of threats no matter how small we think we are.

Social engineering is when attackers manipulate people into giving away information, usually by pretending to be someone they trust. It can come in many forms: phishing emails, fake phone calls, or even people impersonating friends online.

I can’t stress enough how important it is to be vigilant:

⚠️ Double-check any requests for personal or financial information—even if they seem to come from someone you know.

⚠️ Verify before you click on links or download files from emails or messages.

⚠️ Stay cautious if something feels off in conversations, especially if someone is pressuring you for quick responses.

Let’s all look out for each other! Take a moment to review your online security practices and share this with your friends and family.

Let’s stay smart and stay safe. 💙

#StaySafe #SocialEngineering #CyberSecurity #ProtectYourself #AwarenessMatters
